title: O-negative donors needed — paediatric surgery on 22 Aug
description: Two units of O-negative required at Sassoon General for a scheduled paediatric cardiac procedure. Donors must be 18-60, unmedicated and available between 08:00 and 14:00. Transport within Pune city is reimbursed.

title: ₹40,000 short for Anganwadi Centre 15 plumbing
description: Structural quote came in above estimate after the walkthrough revealed a failed underground line. Looking for one or two clubs or a CSR partner to close the gap before the 6 September work date. Full itemised quote and audited utilisation report provided.

title: Co-host wanted: joint RYLA session on community mediation
description: We have the venue and two trained facilitators for a half-day mediation practice session at RYLA 3131. Looking for one partner club to co-host, share delegate outreach and split the facilitator honorarium.

title: 18 volunteers for river cleanup Phase 4 (early morning)
description: Phase 4 covers Bund Garden to Yerwada bridge. We need eighteen more hands for the 06:30 start, ideally with prior segregation experience. Gloves, grabbers and bags are provided; closed-toe footwear is mandatory.

title: 240 age-graded books for the Kothrud literacy circle
description: Looking for Marathi and English readers graded for ages 6-11. Gently used is completely fine; we sort and repair before handover. Pickup can be arranged anywhere in Pune or Pimpri-Chinchwad.

title: Mentors wanted: design and product, 6 sessions over 12 weeks
description: Nine mentees are waiting on a design or product mentor for the winter ladder. Commitment is six forty-five-minute sessions across twelve weeks, scheduled to your availability. Prior mentoring experience is not required — we run a ninety-minute onboarding.

title: Projector and PA system on loan for a two-day district event
description: Hosting 80 RYLA delegates in Lonavala on 14-15 November and would rather borrow than rent. Transport, insurance and a returnable deposit are on us. Any club within 120km can help.

title: Looking for a club to replicate the open-books format
description: We published our quarterly accounts template and wanted one club to trial it and report back honestly on what broke. RAC Nashik Grape City has taken this up — thank you.

title: Sponsor for printed literacy workbooks (unverified poster)
description: Community volunteer looking for a printing sponsor for 300 workbooks. This listing was posted by an account that has not yet been verified by its club secretary — it appears here without the verified badge so readers can weigh it accordingly.
